card_text: A burst fade for Roswell: the arc behind the ear, the 285 drive and when to come back for it.

seo.title: Burst Fade for Roswell, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Burst fades for Roswell, cut in Carlsbad about an hour and a half south on US 285. How the arc grows out, what to book and how to time the trip.

paragraphs: The burst is the half-moon of skin that curves behind the ear and opens back out into the hair, with the nape left fuller than a regular fade would leave it. My chair is in Carlsbad at {{address}}, {{city:roswell.drive_mi}} miles down {{city:roswell.route}} from Roswell, so you pass through Artesia on the way and spend about {{city:roswell.drive_min}} minutes getting here (OpenStreetMap routing).
That distance changes how I'd talk to you about this cut, so this page is about the arc, the drive and the booking.

blocks.heading: The curve is the part that needs you back.
paragraphs: Everything in a burst fade grows at the same speed, but the skin behind the ear is cut the closest, so it's the first thing that stops looking deliberate.

If you'd rather not make the {{city:roswell.drive_min}}-minute run south every time the arc goes fuzzy, tell me that in the chair. I can set the burst a touch higher and leave the blend a little longer, so it fades out gracefully instead of looking like it's waiting for a trim.

blocks.heading: Where the sweat collects.
paragraphs: Roswell gets around {{city:roswell.days_100f}} days a year at 100°F or hotter, with a typical July high of {{city:roswell.july_high_f}} (Open-Meteo, 2023–25). The patch behind and above the ear is where hair traps heat under a cap or a helmet, and a burst takes that patch to skin while keeping your length on top and in back.

blocks.heading: What goes on Booksy.
blocks.lead: The burst is cut inside either haircut service.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: The burst, the top and the back, with the neckline taken clean by straight razor before I style it.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: Adds beard work, a hot towel and razor detailing. If the beard is part of the look, this is the one.

blocks.heading: Roswell to Carlsbad for a burst.

items.q: Is a burst fade worth a {{city:roswell.drive_mi}}-mile drive?
items.a: That's your call, not mine. What I can promise is a clean arc and an honest answer about how long it will hold, so you can decide how often to make the trip.

items.q: Can I pair the burst with a mullet on the same visit?
items.a: Yes. A burst fade mullet is one haircut, booked as the Essential or the Signature. Bring a photo and say how long you want the back.

items.q: How do I describe the fade I want if I've never had a burst?
items.a: Say burst fade, then tell me whether you want the top left curly or textured and how much to keep at the nape. The burst fade page has the side view to point at.
